title: CBSP21 Patch Manifest v2 (code-analysis-tool)
description: v2 adds the fields the pr_scope detector needs: an immutable pinned base commit, an optional pinned head, and a minimum in-scope coverage threshold. All v1 fields remain.

scope.description: The authorized change surface. At least one of files_expected_to_change / paths_in_scope must be non-empty; an empty scope is rejected by pr_scope rather than flagging every changed file.

paths_in_scope.description: Directory prefixes. A changed file is declared if it sits under any of these (e.g. "src/code_audit/analyzers/").

files_expected_to_change.description: File paths or fnmatch glob patterns (e.g. "tests/fixtures/expected/*.json"). Note that "*" also matches "/", so a glob can span directories.

min_coverage_percent.description: Minimum percentage of merge-base..HEAD changed files that must fall inside the declared scope. 95 is the acceptance-contract floor; this field may only raise the bar, never lower it, and fractional thresholds are not supported.

base.description: Base ref (e.g. "main") that pr_scope resolves and passes to `git merge-base` to compute the actual merge-base.

base_sha.description: Immutable pinned merge-base commit. pr_scope compares it against the merge-base actually computed from `base` and raises a HIGH base-drift finding if they differ. Required: without a pin, drift detection would silently never run.

pinned_merge_base.description: Deprecated alias for base_sha, accepted for manifests written against the earlier v2 draft. Prefer base_sha; if both are present, base_sha wins.

head_sha.description: Optional pinned head commit. When set, pr_scope raises a HIGH head-drift finding if the reviewed head has moved.

changed_files_count.description: Declared count of changed files. pr_scope reconciles this against the real diff and raises HIGH on mismatch.

changed_files_exact.description: Declared exact changed-file list. pr_scope reconciles this against the real diff and raises HIGH on mismatch, reporting manifest_only / git_only. This is a cross-check, NOT an authorization list — scope is granted only by scope.files_expected_to_change / scope.paths_in_scope.

file_context_coverage_percent.description: Author's declaration of how much of each touched file's context was actually read before editing (a review-discipline metric, NOT test coverage and NOT the scope-coverage figure pr_scope computes from the diff). pr_scope holds it to the same threshold as scope coverage; metadata.triggered_by names which metric tripped.
